"""Verify published loss means, document links and the unchanged running recipe."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import psutil

REPO=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V175-fresh-noise-matching-v2'


def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p).absolute();return dict(path=str(p),sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())


def main():
 result_path=REPO/'docs/results/v175-four-pass-training-loss-v1.json'
 result=read(result_path)
 assert result['status']=='completed-descriptive-four-pass-training-loss-reduction-not-quality'
 assert result['continuation_rows']==4000 and result['noisy_updates']==3600
 assert result['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']==350 and result['exact_FP32_loss_totals_rechecked']==3600
 assert all(result[k]==0 for k in ['neural_forwards','checkpoint_loads','optimizer_updates','sensor_draws'])
 assert not result['Torch_imported'] and not result['rawpy_imported']
 assert ref(result['source']['path'])=={k:result['source'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
 assert Path(result['source']['path']).read_text()==result['source']['text']
 binding=result['journal_prefix']
 with Path(binding['path']).open('rb') as stream:data=stream.read(binding['bytes'])
 assert len(data)==binding['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==binding['sha256']
 assert len(result['groups'])==20 and len(result['first_to_fourth_paired_reductions'])==50
 plan=read(ROOT/'plan-v1.json');assert ref(ROOT/'plan-v1.json')==result['plan']
 assert len(plan['prior_neural_hashes'])==96
 for name,digest in plan['prior_neural_hashes'].items():assert ref(REPO/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==digest
 post=read(ROOT/'postprocess-inputs-v1.json')
 for binding in post['helpers']:assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 assert len(post['helpers'])==18
 trial=ROOT.parent/'V178-phase-evidence-trial-v1';draft=read(trial/'draft-v1.json')
 neural=list((REPO/'src/demosaic').glob('*.py'));assert len(neural)==97
 for path in neural:assert path.read_bytes()==(Path(draft['work'])/'src/demosaic'/path.name).read_bytes()
 owners=[]
 for folder,launch,status in [(ROOT,'train-launch-v1.json','train-status-v1.json'),
   (ROOT,'completion-watch-launch-v1.json','completion-watch-status-v1.json'),
   (ROOT.parent/'V178-phase-evidence-admission-v1','watch-launch-v1.json','watch-status-v1.json'),
   (trial,'controller-launch-v1.json','controller-status-v1.json')]:
  owner=read(folder/launch)['owner'];p=psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
  assert p.create_time()==owner['created'] and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
  assert not list(folder.glob('*failure-v1.json'))
  owners.append(dict(root=str(folder),owner=owner,status=read(folder/status)))
 docs=[REPO/name for name in ['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/experiments.md','docs/research.md',
       'docs/fresh-noise-matching.md','diary/2026-11-07-21-20-24-fresh-noise-training-loss-prefix.md']]
 links=0
 for path in docs:
  for link in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
   if link.startswith(('http:','https:','mailto:','#')):continue
   assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().exists(),(path,link)
   links+=1
 prose=(REPO/'docs/fresh-noise-matching.md').read_text()
 for token in ['0.189039 → 0.188861 (−0.094%)','0.247964 → 0.248109 (+0.059%)',
               '0.314902 → 0.315394 (+0.156%)','−0.558%','+4.797%','59.61% → 46.91%']:
  assert token in prose
 output=REPO/'docs/results/v175-four-pass-training-loss-publication-v1.json'
 proof=dict(status='pass-training-loss-source-prefix-doc-links-and-unchanged-live-owners',
  recorded_local=datetime.datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat(),
  reduction=ref(result_path),prefix_hash_checked=True,documents=[ref(p) for p in docs],
  local_links_checked=links,training_table_tokens_checked=6,
  original_neural_sources_unchanged=96,current_neural_files_exact_trial_snapshot=97,
  sealed_V175_helpers_unchanged=18,observed_live_owners=owners,
  new_neural_forwards=0,new_sensor_draws=0,new_checkpoint_loads=0,
  scope='Publication hashes/bindings/text checks only. Actual loss reduction independently checks350 means/3600 totals and is descriptive training data,not model quality. Process liveness is timestamp-specific. No training or queued recipe changes.',
  source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
 with output.open('x') as stream:json.dump(proof,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
 print('PASS loss source/prefix/table/links',links,'and four live owners; original code unchanged',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
